persons.name: Jayabhūpatīndramalla
persons.evidence: śrīśrījayabhūpatīndra(4)malla mahārājādhirājasana, ... thva sāphuli dayakase bijyāṅāva

date.as_written: samvat 838(?) āṣaḍamāse, śuklapakṣe, catuthyāṃ tithau, maghanakṣe(3)tre, sūlayoge, ādityavāsare

purpose: ṅātāpolala devalayā hnapātayāguli gātha seṅāva hanoṃ lipota thānakāva thva gātha duteyatā thva sāphuli dayakase bijyāṅāva
notes: The manuscript was ordered to be made by King Bhūpatīndra Malla of Bhaktapur on the occasion of the ritual offering/restoration of a bell (ghaṇṭhā/gātha) at the Nyatapola temple (ṅātāpola devala).
